title: Move a flow from dev to production
subtitle: Build in a solution, map connections and variables, then deploy with Pipelines.

steps.title: Build the flow in a solution in dev
steps.evidence: Build the flow in a solution in dev, export it as managed, and import it into test and production via Pipelines.

steps.title: Set connections per environment
steps.evidence: The connection reference points to it, and you choose a connection for each environment at import.

steps.title: Use environment specific values
steps.evidence: environment-specific values like SharePoint sites belong in environment variables.

steps.title: Deploy managed to test and prod
steps.evidence: Pipelines deploy managed solutions and require the target environments to be Managed Environments.
